diabolo_throw_catch_truth — DRIVE diabolo op

• Data kinds: signal × signal × matrix × table → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.diabolo_throw_catch_truth(p0, v0, sticks, params: 'dict', *, t_min: 'float' = 0.0, t_max: 'float' = 5.0, n_grid: 'int' = 2001) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import diabolo; diabolo.diabolo_throw_catch_truth(p0, v0, sticks, params: 'dict', *, t_min: 'float' = 0.0, t_max: 'float' = 5.0, n_grid: 'int' = 2001) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("diabolo_throw_catch_truth"))

Usage

The first time at which the parabola (closed form) from the release state (p0, v0), after its apex, enters the region "below the plane joining the sticks and s < c_F" relative to the catching sticks sticks (fixed (2, 3)) (the paper's FLYING → ON_STRING condition + the plane rule; the caller checks that the string is taut).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

頂点 t_apex = v_z/g、高さ v_z²/(2g) も返す。根は n_grid 点の格子で符号の変化を見つけ、二分法(80 回)で詰める。受けが無ければ t_catch = NaN。Raises ValueError: 形、t_max ≤ t_min、n_grid < 3。
